court: In the High Court of Madras
advocates: For Respondents: Mr. S. Yogaraja Sekar, Government Advocate (Criminal Side)
prayer: Prayer: Writ Petition (Criminal) is filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India, praying to issue a writ of mandamus, directing the respondents to grant permission and police protection to conduct the Santhanakoodu festival on 30-5-2026 and 31-5-2026 in government land near the bus stand and adjacent to the Dargah at V. Kalathur Village, Perambalur District.
judgment_text:
The Order of the Court was delivered by

Mohammed Shaffiq, J.:— By consent of learned counsel on both sides, this writ petition is taken up for final disposal at the admission stage itself.

2. This Writ Petition (Criminal) has been filed for issuance of writ of mandamus directing the respondents to grant permission and police protection to conduct the Santhanakoodu festival on 30-5-2026 and 31-5-2026 near the bus stand and adjacent to the Dargah at V. Kalathur Village, Perambalur District.

3. The learned government advocate (Criminal Side) for the respondents filed a counter affidavit and submitted that while the festival is scheduled to be conducted on 30-5-2026 and 31-5-2026, the petitioner has also proposed to conduct a musical programme as part of the festival. He further submitted that after considering the ground realities and the decision taken in the Peace Committee Meeting, the respondent police granted permission for the musical programme only for one day i.e. on 31-5-2026. He would further submit that since persons belonging to different religions reside in the petitioner's village, granting permission to conduct the said programme for two days may cause inconvenience to others. Hence, the said musical/orchestra programme shall be confined to only one day alone in order to avoid any untoward incident.

4. In response, the learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that the musical/orchestra programme would be conducted only on 31-5-2026.

5. Recording the above submission, this Writ Petition (Criminal) stands disposed of with a direction permitting the petitioner to conduct the Santhanakoodu festival on 30-5-2026 near the bus stand and adjacent to the Dargah at V. Kalathur Village, Perambalur District, subject to the condition that the musical programme shall be conducted only on 31-5-2026. There shall be no order as to costs.
